task.description:
WF-03 Step 00: Git setup for PD-UI-08 fix.

1. Checkout main, pull latest: git checkout main && git pull --ff-only origin main
2. Create feature branch: git checkout -b feature/WF03-f3a-pdui08-fix-20260530
3. Push the branch: git push origin feature/WF03-f3a-pdui08-fix-20260530
4. Verify: git branch --show-current must output feature/WF03-f3a-pdui08-fix-20260530

The branch is needed for the subsequent ISSUE-FIXER step to fix TC-PDUI08-03.
acceptance_criteria: Branch exists on origin (git fetch origin && git branch -r shows it)

result.summary: Feature branch feature/WF03-f3a-pdui08-fix-20260530 created from main and pushed to origin.
